title: Building a data plane from scratch: Stripe’s own high-performance distributed proxy
summary: Fixes connection floods from Envoy's per-core workers with mesh-proxy, a Go proxy that shares one connection per host.

title: How Stripe’s document databases supported 99.999% uptime with zero-downtime data migrations

title: Stripe’s payments APIs: The first 10 years
summary: Swaps card-shaped Charges and Sources, which broke on async and redirect methods, for one PaymentIntents state machine.
